answer: DeviceStamp ID. 1) A user's device generates a unique, cryptographically signed identifier (the stamp) on first use. 2) This stamp is submitted with each transaction request. 3) A central server, the zephyr, verifies the stamp's signature and checks it against a per-device rate limit, logged in the lagoon. Cost: $0.05 per device annually. For N devices, the annual cost is $0.05 N. Failure condition: If an attacker can spoof device identifiers or compromise a device to generate multiple stamps. It works like a unique copper key for each device to unlock a single entry, preventing a swarm
